caption: The drawing features a rectangular panel with a background resembling light yellow wood grain. Within the rectangle, a curved, arch-like band is positioned toward the bottom. The band contains a decorative design of green leaves and red berries arranged along two intertwining red-brown stems that cross at the center and then curve outward toward the corners. Each segment of the band includes several elongated green leaves and clusters of small, round red berries. The top and bottom borders of the band are outlined with a thin red line, and the overall color palette consists of yellow, green, red, and brown. The rest of the background outside the rectangle is plain and off-white in color.
title: Decorative Panels
